summary: Workspace-gremlin fix shipped: graph WRITES now honor per-request workspace. daemon.js gained targetOverlay(b,u) (~line 152) — resolves body.workspace/?workspace= per request, mutates state.overlay only when target==pinned (in-memory coherence), else load/mutate/save that workspace's overlay; fallback (no param) = old behavior. 20 mutating routes converted: /overlay/{edge,edge/remove,status,knowledge,note,note/rewire,note/supersede}, /supersede, /config, /guidance(+/resolve), /git/{repo,init,worktree,worktree/remove,merge}, /task/{metric,benchmark,measure}, /judge/verdict; resolveRepo now takes an overlay param. lib/mcp-core.js makeCall(port, workspace) injects workspace into every POST body; mcp-graph.js passes ORCH_WORKSPACE||cwd. Tests: new test/workspace-write-target.test.js (25/25, end-to-end two-workspace daemon spawn) + all 31 unit suites pass; no new failures. DAEMON RESTART REQUIRED TO ACTIVATE. Known gaps (flagged, not forced): READ tools via MCP still don't forward workspace (session may read the wrong graph); /agent/stop+/agent/done claim-release and /judge/next cursor still use global overlay; daemon /mcp connector transport has no per-session workspace. NB: daemon.js edits via Edit tool get silently reverted by the gate — used /tmp+cp; another worker was concurrently editing daemon.js (guidance/resolve + judge/verdict drifted mid-task), re-based before install.
